purpose: Dedicated receptionist and housekeeping hiring/management icons

prompts.receptionist: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE dedicated premium hand-painted RASTER UI icon for hiring and managing a hotel RECEPTIONIST in original cozy tycoon Hotel Empire. A compact warm oak clipboard with jade-green backing visible, ivory sheet with ONLY three broad neutral horizontal strokes (no readable text), brass clip at top. One large old-fashioned brass room key laid diagonally across lower half, round bow and clearly defined teeth. Strong simple silhouette of clipboard AND key, unmistakable front desk administrative work. Slight frontal three-quarter perspective, warm upper-left light, softly modeled painted wood/paper/brass materials, polished original cozy game style matching jade/oak/brass/ivory palette. Square 1:1 canvas, entire clipboard and key centered occupy maximum 80% canvas height and width, at least 8% transparent margin on every side. Actual transparent RGBA background, no scene/table/floor, cast shadow outside object, UI frame/badge, human, portrait, labels, letters, numbers, logo/watermark, tiny detached particles. Not SVG/vector/flat clipart/pixel art/photograph. Must read at 36px native hiring button and 48px staff panel. ONE icon only.
prompts.cleaner: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE dedicated premium hand-painted RASTER UI icon for hiring and managing hotel HOUSEKEEPING staff of original cozy Hotel Empire. A compact jade green cleaning bucket with polished brass handle and oak accent, a single ivory cotton mop leaning diagonally into bucket, wooden mop handle with dusty rose grip cap, mop head draped visibly over near bucket rim. Strong simple complete silhouette, bucket dominates lower half and mop rises upper left, clearly housekeeping work. Slight frontal three-quarter perspective, warm upper-left light, softly modeled painted wood/cotton/enamel/brass materials, original cozy game art with jade/oak/brass/ivory/dusty rose palette. Square 1:1 canvas, whole bucket, handle and mop centered fit within 80% width and height with at least 8% fully transparent padding on all sides. Actual transparent RGBA. No water spills, bubbles, droplets, cleaning cart, floor, room, external cast shadow, UI frame/badge, human/portrait, labels, letters/numbers/logo/watermark, detached particles. Not SVG/vector/flat clipart/pixel art/photo. Readable at 36px hiring button and 48px staff panel. ONE icon only.
